DeployBot: [DEPLOY-REPORT] Canary rollout rc/2026-03-21 -> canary-1: SBOM/vuln-scan failed for target 'canary-arm64' only. Summary: 1 transitive MEDIUM CVE in libnetx (CVE-2026-1234). Not present in canary-amd64. Report: https://ci.redwood.internal/scans/3492003456 :eyes:
Lara: saw it. is the arm64 artifact coming from a different mirror/build matrix?
Oso: yes — buildx pulled a newer resolver path for arm64 due to mirror timeout; amd64 used v1.2.2 of libnetx, arm64 ended up with v1.2.3.
Riz: can you paste the vuln details? need exploitability + any available fixes.
Oso: snippet: ```
libnetx@1.2.3 - CVE-2026-1234
severity: MEDIUM
path: product -> depA -> libnetx
exploitability: LOW (requires chained local conditions)
fix: libnetx@1.2.4 available; mitigation: pin to 1.2.2 (used on amd64) or upgrade to 1.2.4
```
QA_Maya: canary metrics showed a ~2% error increase on arm64 after deploy, not present on amd64. small but correlated to deploy window.
Riz: given LOW exploitability, my security recommendation is a timeboxed targeted pin for arm64 while we rebuild with a proper lockfile + run exploitability eval. full rollback seems heavy.
Lara: ok. seeking release manager approval for a partial carveout: pin arm64 -> libnetx@1.2.2 and rebuild/push. ETA?
Jen: legal: fine with targeted carveout provided we record it in release notes and track remediation. no regulatory block.
DeployBot: Suggested commands:
`# option A: targeted rollback for arm64 to previous image`
`deploybot rollback --target canary-arm64 --image rc/2026-03-21~amd64`
`# option B: rebuild arm64 with pinned dep`
`deploybot rebuild --target canary-arm64 --pin libnetx@1.2.2`
Oso: launching rebuild with pinned lockfile now (job #5483). ETA ~40m. will push new digest and update canary.
QA_Maya: will monitor post-push and run focused smoke tests on arm64. tagging @oncall for watch. :mag:
Riz: note for follow-up: schedule upgrade to libnetx@1.2.4 with regression eval; this pin is timeboxed 48h unless we see anything concerning.
Lara: proceeding with targeted pin+rebuild. if errors spike >5% or new vuln evidence appears, we'll trigger full rollback.
DeployBot: [ACTION-LOG] Rebuild queued (#5483). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/5483. ETA ~35m.
